# Tsiribihina Descent

> Tsiribihina River trips by pirogue or chaland — Madagascar. A small local team based in Morondava, Madagascar, specialised in the Tsiribihina River descent (Miandrivazo to Belo-sur-Tsiribihina, 3 days / 2 nights) by traditional pirogue or motorised chaland, with extensions to Kirindy Forest, the Avenue of the Baobabs and the Tsingy de Bemaraha. Season: April to November. Quotes on WhatsApp: +261331847692.

## Trips
- [The Classic Tsiribihina Descent](https://hugonantenaina.github.io/tsiribihina-descent/tsiribihina-river-descent-3-days/): 3 days, Miandrivazo → Belo-sur-Tsiribihina.
- [River & Kirindy Forest](https://hugonantenaina.github.io/tsiribihina-descent/tsiribihina-river-kirindy-forest-4-days/): 4 days, Miandrivazo → Belo → Kirindy → Morondava.
- [River, Kirindy & the Baobabs](https://hugonantenaina.github.io/tsiribihina-descent/tsiribihina-river-kirindy-baobabs-5-days/): 5 days, Miandrivazo → Belo → Kirindy → Morondava.
- [River, Tsingy & Kirindy](https://hugonantenaina.github.io/tsiribihina-descent/tsiribihina-river-tsingy-kirindy-6-days/): 6 days, Miandrivazo → Belo → Bekopaka → Kirindy → Morondava.
- [The Grand Tsiribihina Expedition](https://hugonantenaina.github.io/tsiribihina-descent/grand-tsiribihina-expedition-8-days/): 8 days, Antananarivo → Antsirabe → river → Tsingy → Kirindy → Morondava.
